# Synthetic HEBELTRADER-style fixtures

All PDFs here were generated specifically for tests with ReportLab, using
invented companies, instruments and numbers. They contain no publisher content.
`complete` separates derivative and underlying values; `multiple` contains two
recommendations; `table` contains ruled cells; `incomplete` contains invalid and
conflicting data; `metadata_conflict`, `no_date`, `scan` and `broken` cover failures.
The blank scan fixture represents a PDF without an extractable text layer.
